notes: Build 55 / 2.6.16 adds first-run welcome persistence, optional Android face/fingerprint/device-PIN unlock, centered OK dialogs, button press feedback, a single-row tier carousel, date-grouped notifications and client-safe payment status labels. AI chat messages now trigger a redacted support Telegram alert. Payment approval controls and PRE_PRODUCTION locks are unchanged.
Build 54 / 2.6.15 keeps the Deposit page in the original centered mobile-web single-column shape on web and native app, uses full-width Tier cards, and improves dark-mode receiving-address contrast.
Build 53 / 2.6.14 restores the compact, stacked Deposit screen in the native Android app while keeping the desktop web layout wide; mobile Tier cards use the full available width.

Build 52 / 2.6.13 caps chat bubbles at 45%, hides the known malformed legacy merged transcript from the Client only, preserves the complete Admin transcript, hides AI shortcuts while a representative is live, routes escalations into the joined representative case and prevents repeated legacy message blobs.

Build 51 / 2.6.12 uses intrinsic Telegram-style message bubbles: bubble width follows content, long messages wrap within a 78% chat-width cap, and sender labels no longer widen short messages. Font size remains 12px.

Build 50 / 2.6.11 sizes AI support bubbles to their text with a compact readable font, makes the live-representative card focus the chat instead of presenting a wait cursor, and clears Client-local support history when Master Admin resolves the case while preserving the Admin transcript. Backend now returns an explicit clientChatCleared signal.

Build 49 / 2.6.10 removes duplicate AI chat banners, hides the repeated live-representative status, and clears stale resolved support-case session pointers while preserving the visible transcript. The non-interactive, preloaded Cloudflare Turnstile improvements remain included.

Build 48 / 2.6.9 preloads Cloudflare Turnstile on the login screen, retries transient verification failures automatically, and uses non-interactive verification so users do not need to tick a checkbox. Server-side token validation remains required.
Build 47 / 2.6.8 makes the AI Support plus attachment button visibly separate from the message input and bumps the service-worker cache so the latest chat controls replace stale app-shell markup.
Build 46 / 2.6.7 restores the exact Client screen after returning from the external Shop marketplace and briefly retries Auth session hydration to avoid a transient login flash.

The marketplace now renders real seed photos immediately, prioritizes the first four visible product images, and replaces seed photos with matching public-catalog photos when the catalog finishes loading.
Assigned product images load directly without a separate image-probe request; a local image fallback remains available.
Retains Build 45 / 2.6.6 startup optimizations, user-started Cloudflare Turnstile, the 12–128 character password policy, and server-side breached-password checks.
This is a test-channel fallback manifest. The Web Portal Deploy workflow generates versioned APK URLs and SHA-256 values from the exact packaged Client and Master Admin APKs.
